understanding: Weak Mars gravity means the fall lacks enough force to snap the neck.
evidence: Because the gravity on Mars is a fraction of Earth's. So when a man is dropped from a gallows with a rope around his neck, the fall doesn't generate enough force
before: a gravity icon beside a full force tank
transformation: Mars gravity leaves the fall's force low
after: the force tank is low, old level dashed

camera.purpose: gravity and force in one frame
